snippet.title: Cosmic Miners | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on an epic space adventure in Cosmic Miners! Mine rare resources, upgrade your ship, and navigate the treacherous depths of space. Forge alliances (or rivalries) with powerful factions, engage in tactical space combat, and carve out your destiny among the stars.

Will you dominate the galactic economy, explore the unknown, or become the most feared miner in the cosmos? Your choices shape the universe.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3329630/Cosmic_Miners
Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/36bPmwMaTN
